counterfactual_missing_items: specific mention of Mycosis Fungoides subtype
distinctive histopathological features of Mycosis Fungoides
exclusion of other cutaneous T-cell lymphoma subtypes
decisive_items: atypical lymphocytes with focal areas of epidermotropism
clonal amplification product for the γ-chain of the T-cell receptor
Positive for CD2, CD3, CD4, and CD45RO
response.rationale: R2 is the champion because it has more comprehensive support from the vignette, including clinical presentation, histopathology, and immunohistochemical staining, all of which are consistent with Mycosis Fungoides, a subtype of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. R3, while similar, lacks the breadth of supporting evidence found in R2.

rejected.why: C1 is too specific and does not capture the full scope of the diagnosis as well as R2 does.
